name: qf_tyres_bike
character: The Hero's tyres letting go: a narrow-tyre stick-slip tone near 1.4 kHz with its harmonics and a scrub of noise at the launch, the drift, the hard slide, the wall and the last corner.
note: The tone is a pulse train at 1400 Hz with harmonics through a tyre-cavity resonance, wobbling near 7 Hz with the slip, over a scrub of noise; its pitch and level follow the slide (stick-slip: a self-excited oscillation at the contact, lateral creep the trigger). ESTIMATE: the tone, its harmonics and the cavity formants are starting values (no source gave a tyre-squeal frequency); the squeal times are the drift and corner moments of the picture
